steps.tx: **Enterobacterales** are gut gram negatives lethal outside bowel; **E coli and Klebsiella** cause most hospital infections. **Lactose, citrate and motility** sort them at the bench. **Resistance travels on plasmids**, so patterns change yearly. **Blood with urine cultures** name culprits; local antibiograms guide empiric cover.
steps.say: Enterobacterales are gut gram negatives that turn lethal outside the bowel, and E coli with Klebsiella cause most hospital infections. Lactose with citrate with motility is used to sort them at the bench, while blood with urine cultures name the culprit. Resistance travels on plasmids, so yesterday's sensitive bug is today's nightmare. Knowing local patterns beats any single guideline.

steps.tx: **E coli UTI** needs symptoms with pyuria; **cloudy bags alone** mean nothing. **Asymptomatic bacteriuria** is treated only in pregnancy and before urology. **Young women** take short oral courses; **men with fever** need longer prostate cover. **Catheters out fastest** as biofilm beats drugs. **Recurrence triggers** anatomy review.

steps.tx: **Klebsiella liver abscess** strikes diabetics with **single large lesions** seeding eyes and lungs. **Hypervirulent string positive** strains dominate East Asia. **Drainage with prolonged cover** cures most. **Endophthalmitis blinds** without intravitreal rescue. **Blood cultures with eye examination** are mandatory in every single case.

steps.tx: **ESBLs** destroy penicillins and cephalosporins but **spare carbapenems**. **Ceftriaxone failure** is the bedside clue; laboratory testing confirms. **Carbapenems lead** treatment. **Piperacillin with tazobactam** suits mild low risk disease. **Contact precautions with hand hygiene** stop ward spread. **Bladder cover alone** never needs carbapenems.

steps.tx: **AmpC** hides chromosomally and **emerges on cephalosporins**; day 3 failure is classic. **Enterobacter, Citrobacter and Serratia** carry inducible genes. **Cefepime resists** the enzyme and leads. **Carbapenems saved** for severe disease. **Repeat cultures** catch emergence early; de-escalate when stable and sensitive.
steps.say: AmpC enzymes hide on chromosomes and emerge during cephalosporin therapy, turning day three failures into nightmares. Enterobacter with Citrobacter with Serratia carry the inducible gene, so ceftriaxone with ceftazidime select resistance even when first sensitive. Cefepime resists the enzyme and leads treatment, while carbapenems are saved for severe disease. Repeat cultures are catching emergence early.

steps.tx: **CRE** carries **KPC, NDM or OXA** enzymes; bloodstream mortality reaches half. **Rectal screening** finds carriers; **cohort nursing** slows spread. **Polymyxin with newer combinations** treats by laboratory guidance. **Kidneys are watched** on polymyxin therapy. **Every case** triggers infection control review and contact tracing.
steps.say: Carbapenem resistant Enterobacterales carry K P C with N D M with O X A enzymes and kill half of bloodstream victims. Rectal screening finds carriers on admission to high risk units, and cohort nursing with dedicated equipment slows spread. Polymyxin with newer combinations treats susceptible patterns, guided by laboratory testing always. Polymyxin dosing harms kidneys, so levels with function are watched closely.

steps.tx: **Urinary source bacteraemia** has the best prognosis with **drained bladder and right cover**. **Shock with source control** decides intensive care. **Follow up cultures** document clearance. **Echo follows** persistent bacteraemia. **7 days** suffices for uncomplicated urinary sources cleared fast with drained foci.
steps.say: Bloodstream infection from urine sources carries the best prognosis when the bladder is drained and cover is right. Pitt scores with shock with source control decide intensive care, not the organism name alone. Follow up cultures document clearance, and echocardiography follows persistent bacteraemia. steps.tx: **Empiric cover** follows severity, source and local patterns; **shock earns broad** beta lactams at once. **Stable cystitis** waits for culture. **De-escalate at seventy two hours**; audits enforce it. **Intravenous to oral switch** follows stability with working guts. **Duration is counted** from clearance and control.

steps.tx: **Infection control** beats plasmids: **hand hygiene, isolation and stewardship** form the tripod. **Carriers flagged** on readmission; equipment dedicated to cohorts. **Outbreaks close wards** for cleaning. **Audits cut** carbapenem overuse. **Leadership rounds** make resistance visible and change habits faster than guidelines.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** cloudy bags without symptoms need no treatment. **Eye seeding** is missed in Klebsiella bacteraemia without examination. **Day 3 failure** means AmpC emergence, not wrong drug. **Polymyxin never alone**. **Precautions precede** laboratory proof in outbreaks. **Persistent bugs** always earn echocardiography.
